High-resolution (600 dpi) scans of printed Decipher cards from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]], uploaded as WebP (quality 90) with the card corners made transparent. Each File page names the original TIFF and its SHA-256. On every file the outer black border is a uniform digital fill; the inside of the card's frame is the scanned card (<code><nowiki>{{HiRez scan note}}</nowiki></code> says so on each File page).

strangewayes' re-made images (Two-Player cards re-coloured to a black border, print-ready errata cards and virtual card renders) are not scans of printed cards. They are in [[:Category:Strangewayes re-made card images]] and are not shown on card articles (decision of 28 November 2026).

Card articles that show one of these files as their High-Res Scan are in [[:Category:Cards with high-res scans]].
